verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs show you can clone repositories with Git, an open format, or download zip snapshots, so code leaves cleanly. The pack has no documented whole-account export covering issues, PRs, discussions or Actions. Community users describe exactly those as the lock-in and propose third-party tools like git-bug as a workaround, which earns no credit. The REST/GraphQL APIs can retrieve data, but they are developer building blocks, not an export feature. missing for 10: documented full account/migration export of issues, PRs, wikis, discussions and Actions config in open formats; any independent confirmation of a complete exit path.
